purpose: Repair scoped CSS media-policy invalidation and false clipping of ordinary inline text.
approach: Retain scope context through nested CSS groups; relevant :scope and implicit & declarations are uncertain even if Element.matches returns false or cannot parse the selector. Existing unmasked browser-cascade validation then checks the media contract.
Ignore ineffective overflow/sizing/text-indent clipping declarations on inline or display:contents boxes, while retaining display:none, opacity, visibility, semantics and descendant clipping checks.
restorationContract: Production edits only change reads/classification; authored text nodes, attributes and styles are never written by these changes.
New collector eligibility uses existing rendering/restore ownership. Tests derive source identities, values, direct-child order, link edits, code edits and transfer destinations from page operations.
Cross bilingual/replace, watching/paused, immediate/delivered records, repeated restore and opposite-mode translation on fresh native artifacts.
testAdjustment: The initial new display:contents fixture put raw text directly in a boxless element. Native tests exposed the existing geometry eligibility limitation. The fixture now verifies visible descendants with their own layout boxes; production scope was not expanded into that unrelated eligibility path. The final272-case run is green.

observations: An initial Apple baseline included3 region-banner units (165 units/66 processed); its source diff contains only the region message, continue control and country selector. A fresh comparable baseline is selected explicitly and all8 chosen source/processed counts match.
Existing clipping/squeeze candidates in GitHub chrome, Apple and Shopify remain at baseline values; none increased in the sampled views.
React500, Vue369 and Stripe257 source code text nodes are retained with no translated code targets or overwritten values. Vue retains its2 source-hidden API tab code blocks.
Stripe native wheel input moves its actual internal content900px in both builds; code and both mode restores remain intact.
limitations: The earlier70-page audit and unrelated native functional suites were not rerun.
The existing media fallback validates observed paint/relative shape rather than implementing the complete CSS cascade.
Raw text directly inside display:contents remains subject to the existing geometry eligibility path; this task covers non-clipping ancestors and descendants with layout boxes.
CSSOM-only changes without an observable event remain outside the update-trigger contract.
Chromium native regressions load the real extension; Firefox uses native Gecko with fresh packaged content and the repository shim. Performance uses default budgets, not strict mode.
